children: Balancer’s official X account said a fork proposal led by MAXYZ has been posted on the forum, with liquidity, contributors, partners, and intellectual property potentially moving to a new protocol. According to ChainCatcher, the proposal is separate from the liquidation proposal.
Discussion is now open, and a Snapshot vote is expected over the weekend.

title: Balancer Fork Proposal Goes Live as Community Discussion Opens
